report:
Reviewed the complete shared-model claim and all three implementation/nine test entries. Source assessment: SpecIndex::load_workspace resolves configured SUMMARY chapters and owned Sage/companion sources into one chapter/anchor inventory, preserving qualified identities, source text, file spans, model ownership and context URLs. Its normative filter excludes generated anchor copies and nonnormative definitions; its disk/document passes diagnose omitted Markdown and Sage sources. xtask check_orphaned_chapters_at consumes this same inventory and rejects unpublished Markdown and inventory diagnostics. The captured xtask CI path invokes sage-meta check and workspace tests.

The complete ordinary test set meaningfully checks: canonical_inventory_uses_configured_chapters_and_local_names asserts exact anchor identities, context URL and normative document count; generated_crate_guides_are_canonical_and_link_to_rendered_sage_chapters asserts owned guide indexing, Sage link conversion, missing-target rejection and omitted-model diagnostics; noncanonical_crates_chapters_do_not_activate_generated_sources asserts the alternate landing does not publish models/guides and both omissions are diagnosed; nonnormative_book_chapters_reference_rules_without_defining_them checks one canonical definition, references, link rendering and unknown-reference rejection; only_owned_crate_guides_are_automatically_published checks owned and explicit chapters versus excluded unowned source; unpublished_rule_sources_do_not_silently_disappear asserts the orphan diagnostic. companion_guides_use_the_nearest_enclosing_crate_in_inventory_and_book compares shared inventory membership to actual preprocessor output paths and nearest-owner breadcrumbs. The xtask orphan test checks generated-guide acceptance, ordinary and unowned orphan rejection, and loss of publication when the canonical landing is removed. Captured fixture helpers establish configured temporary books, real load_workspace/preprocess invocation and unique chapter collection; assertions remain visible in test bodies.

The spec_plan implementation region and generation_and_checking_share_the_design_inventory test remain explicitly TODO. Their prerequisite is completing one inventory for plugin contributions, checking and rendering, with omitted-source and generated-copy protection. Existing ordinary cases cover substantial local inventory behavior but do not establish plugin participation or exhaustive CLI/CI/workspace parity of identities, provenance and correspondence, including the book rules themselves. Those remaining integration guarantees stay deferred under this documented TODO; the empty stub is not behavioral evidence. No N/A entries exist. This independently sustains the prior partial-implementation rationale without treating deferral as completion.

Baseline verification: the claim and all nine associated test functions exactly match historical evidence; spec.rs and spec_plan.rs match whole-file historical bytes. Contrary to the dispatch-time baseline, xtask now has one added meta.reviews.gate association comment, with unchanged behavior. Other deltas in surrounding book/spec tests migrate review records and claim access to fragments and test review presentation; none changes these associated tests or their captured helpers. Current metadata retains the same ordinary/TODO coverage. No requested edits arose from this reassessment.

Execution distinction: I ran review start, review read, exact/delta comparison and review record. I did not run behavioral tests or builds. The coordinator separately reports 321 functional sage-meta tests and the root build passing; these are contextual results, not my execution evidence.
